booking_modal.policy_default:
Cancellation or rescheduling up to 24 hours before the booking – full refund.
Cancellation within 24 hours of the booking or no-show – no refund.
To cancel or reschedule, please contact us by phone.
Your chosen time is held for 15 minutes to complete the payment. If the payment isn't completed within that time, the time is released and the booking is not placed.
If the payment is completed after the time was already taken, we'll contact you to arrange another time or a full refund.
We may cancel a confirmed booking with at least 24 hours' notice, in which case a full refund will be given.
